title: Showroom · Shridhar Athens, Science City
address: A Shridhar Athens, Shivranjani Cross Rd, Nehru Nagar, Ambawadi, Ahmedabad, Gujarat 380015
description: Second floor showroom in A Shridhar Athens near Shivranjani Cross Road, with 5,100 sq.ft super built up and 2,800 sq.ft carpet and a 28 ft frontage.

Located in a G+12 tower with six lifts and six showrooms per floor. Rent is quoted at ₹80 per sq.ft on super built up or ₹145 per sq.ft on carpet. A good fit for fashion, garments, designer and jewellery showrooms.
